reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is integrating a locally authenticated Codex App Server as a selectable model provider, including conversation, tool-context relay, and image input/output support.

summaries.zh: 将本机已登录的 Codex App Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为可选模型提供方处理对话、工具上下文和图片输入输出。
summaries.en: Connects a locally authenticated Codex App Server to DeepSeek Harness as a selectable model provider for conversations, tool context, and image input and output.

capabilities: Registers a local Codex App Server as a DeepSeek Harness model provider
Starts and manages a local Codex CLI subprocess through the host environment
Routes conversation requests, tool results, context, and image attachments between DeepSeek Harness and Codex
Can return Codex-native image generation results to DeepSeek Harness
